target: Spoiler-free 100% completion of the original PSP release through PPSSPP, including all single-player evidence, career rewards, secret weapons, bonus missions, and preserved PSP multiplayer progression

areas.name: Run Setup
areas.location_cue: The title screen, emulator profile, and first save slot.
areas.note: Content authority is the original North American PSP release through PPSSPP; the later PS2 port is not part of this route.

levels.1: Keep the handheld release as the rules authority.
levels.2: Load a verified personal North American PSP dump in PPSSPP.
levels.3: Use the original PSP release with a dedicated PPSSPP profile and normal memory-stick saves. Resolution scaling and controller remapping are safe presentation/access changes; do not use cheats that alter timers, career totals, evidence, rank, or inventory.

levels.1: Protect the profile before long cleanup sessions.
levels.2: Keep a normal in-game save plus rotating mission-start states.
levels.3: Confirm that the PSP save reloads normally, then back up the PPSSPP save folder before emulator updates or preserved-network sessions. Treat save states as temporary recovery tools, never as the sole completion record.

levels.1: Do not mix results from the altered later port.
levels.2: Use PSP mechanics, content, and timing throughout this checklist.
levels.3: The 2007 PS2 version removes the original multiplayer branch and changes presentation and content. It is a separate altered port, so its clears do not replace the PSP online, rank, or badge records in this pack.

levels.1: One setting matters to an entire career category.
levels.2: Clear Story Mode on Normal or Hard, then use Mission Mode for cleanup.
levels.3: A Normal-or-Hard story clear opens both Bangkok bonus missions. Headshots contribute to Career Objectives only on Hard, so use Hard for their mission totals; other categories can be cleaned up through Mission Mode on a comfortable setting.

levels.1: Nothing in a finished mission is lost forever.
levels.2: Use Mission Mode to revisit every cleared story mission.
levels.3: Story completion unlocks that mission for individual replay. Evidence, career goals, timers, and secret weapons can all be retried; fragile pickups may be lost for the current attempt, but no single-player requirement is permanently missable.

areas.name: Training
areas.location_cue: The three selectable exercise courses on the main menu.
areas.note: Training can be completed before Story Mode and is fully replayable.

levels.1: Learn movement, climbing, and traversal shortcuts.
levels.2: Complete the movement course and inspect the container-top practice box.
levels.3: Run the course once normally, then use the two optional RTL lines for the fast route. Climb around the containers before the crawl hole to reach the practice evidence box; it teaches the visual language but is not part of the 72 mission evidence records.

levels.1: Practice the combat instructions before chasing speed.
levels.2: Complete every prompted weapon and movement exercise.
levels.3: Follow each station in order on the first pass. For the FAMAS time, repeat the course without pausing, immediately perform each prompted action, and finish below 3:00.

levels.1: Accuracy matters more than speed in the dart course.
levels.2: Complete all four dart stages without wasting a shot.
levels.3: Hit the three fixed 6 mm targets, wait for clean EDT shots on the moving pair, use one gas dart on the clustered group, then one explosive dart on the last group. Any miss voids the UNP-45 condition, so restart at once.

levels.1: Finish the academy before entering Story Mode.
levels.2: Clear Training Levels 1, 2, and 3.
levels.3: A normal clear of all three training levels opens Goodnight Sweetheart. The three special performance conditions are separate weapon unlocks and may be completed on later attempts.

areas.name: Final Completion Audit
areas.location_cue: The completed profile, Career Objectives, Locked Files, Mission Mode, and multiplayer records.
areas.note: Use this only after every preceding area is complete or honestly marked network-pending.

levels.1: Cross-check every menu rather than relying on the story clear alone.
levels.2: Verify all missions, 72 evidence entries, archive rewards, career meters, secret weapons, bonuses, and PSP online records.
levels.3: Confirm three training clears; twenty-three story missions; five bonus missions; all 72 hidden-evidence slots; every Locked Files reward; 100% in all six Career categories; all eleven separate weapon conditions; every Mission Mode entry and loadout reward; five multiplayer maps, four modes, ranks R0 through T3, and Expert plus Elite in all eight badge tracks. If preserved partners were unavailable, state that branch as pending.
